note: Catalyst Data Store tables for who is in a Pond (ADR 0005). Created by cloud/catalyst-relay/scripts/create-people-tables.mjs. Types: varchar (max 255), text (max 10000), bigint (epoch ms or small counters), int. `unique` is per column and cannot change after the column exists, so composite rules use a derived key column (memberKey = pondId:userId). Never list ROWID, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME or MODIFIEDTIME: Catalyst adds them. Epoch-ms bigint columns stand in for CREATEDTIME.

tables.name: people_accounts
tables.about: An account and the name sign-in gave it. email is lower-case.

tables.name: people_devices
tables.about: A device an account signed in on (kind mac, ios or web).

tables.name: people_ponds
tables.about: A shared Pond: id, owner, name, created.

tables.name: people_memberships
tables.about: One row per account per Pond (memberKey = pondId:userId, unique). In the Pond while slot >= 0 and leftAt = 0.

tables.name: people_slots
tables.about: The 10-person cap without transactions: a member claims slot pondId:0..9, and a taken slot is refused by the unique rule.

tables.name: people_invites
tables.about: The record whose state everyone draws: pending, joined, declined, withdrawn, expired.

tables.name: people_invite_locks
tables.about: One row per pending invite (lockKey = pondId:sha256(email), unique): deleted when the invite stops being pending.
